test_name: Verify Sorting Accessories by Price (Low to High)
description: This test validates that users can sort Accessories products by price from lowest to highest.
steps: Navigate to the Accessories category page.
Select 'Sort by price: low to high' from the dropdown options.
Verify that the page reloads or updates dynamically.
Scroll through the list of sorted products.
Verify that the products are displayed in ascending order of price.
Click on a product to view its details.
Verify that the product price matches the order.

selectors.text: Sort by price: low to high

expected_results: Products are displayed in ascending order of price.
Sorting selection is retained after sorting.
No products are out of order.
edge_cases: No products exist in the Accessories category.
Dropdown menu fails to update the sorting.
Page fails to reload after sorting.
Sorting logic is incorrect or inconsistent.
Products with equal prices are displayed out of order.
data_requirements: Sorting logic implemented on the backend.
Frontend display logic for sorted items.
dependencies: Products must exist in the Accessories category.
api_interactions: API call to fetch sorted products based on price.
performance_metrics: Response time of the sorting operation.
accessibility_requirements: Dropdown menu must have ARIA labels for screen readers.
Ensure keyboard navigation is supported for dropdown options.
Sorting options must be visible and selectable.
